title: 真实位点保留期过期：拒绝latest跳积压，按持久化业务权威安全重放
source: OpsForge 原创编审 2026-10-21；Apache Kafka 4.0 官方文档核对
review_note: Kafka批次5：真实原生机制触发与恢复，动态输入、审批/身份/范围边界及独立语义反例。
body:
## 环境与初始材料
Kafka4.0.0 KRaft、Java17、confluent-kafka2.10.1；真实隔离broker与native客户端，无外部服务/宿主socket，2GiB/2CPU/PID768分布式档。

## 操作任务
实现recover_offsets(config,name,group,ledger,approval,fail_after_effect=False)。夹具真实配置最短1分钟offset保留，原生commit2确实过期为无位点；latest原生启动会跳过旧积压，只能读新消息。approval须明确approved/authority/原topic_id，原组活跃必须拒绝且不重设；读取真实SQLite authority(topic_id,next_offset)与effects(source_offset主键,payload)，核对原topic UUID与实际保留low/high。对停止的原组用原生Admin设到持久化业务checkpoint，然后实际消费至捕获的high。先事务持久化幂等effects与下个业务checkpoint，再同步提交Kafka位点；fail_after_effect必须在实际SQL提交后、Kafka提交前抛RuntimeError供崩溃重试验收。重试从已持久化业务点续接，不重复效果、不丢未提交消息。返回start/end/applied/topic_id。

## 提交产物
solution.py及操作产生的业务状态/审计产物。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；动态真实native数据、前提和错误反例，环境错误不计有效wrong拒绝；120秒内完成。位点过期题包含真实至少1分钟等待。

## 能力边界
真实Kafka4保留期1分钟，完整链路在120秒内，不能用假钟/删组API代替retention过期。单RF1 broker/单分区，已核实权威SQLite业务checkpoint和仍保留的日志范围；非全局业务权威自动发现。验证真实active组拒绝、latest跳积压、原生位点重设、SQL/Kafka非原子边界的幂等续接。

import pathlib,sys,json,time,uuid,os
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks")]
import solution as task
from native import *
import inspect,functools
def _trace_operation(name,function):
    @functools.wraps(function)
    def invoke(*args,**kwargs):
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+name,flush=True)
        try:result=function(*args,**kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RAISED:'+name,flush=True)
            raise
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RETURNED:'+name,flush=True)
        return result
    return invoke
for _name,_function in list(vars(task).items()):
    if not _name.startswith('_') and inspect.isfunction(_function) and _function.__module__=='solution':setattr(task,_name,_trace_operation(_name,_function))
import tempfile,sqlite3
from confluent_kafka import TopicCollection
with broker(overrides={'offsets.retention.minutes':'1','offsets.retention.check.interval.ms':'500','group.min.session.timeout.ms':'500'}) as bootstrap,tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='offset-expiry-ledger-') as directory:
    cfg={'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap,'log_level':0};admin=AdminClient(cfg);name='expired-'+uuid.uuid4().hex;group='group-'+uuid.uuid4().hex;topic(bootstrap,name)
    original=[uuid.uuid4().bytes for _ in range(5)];producer=Producer(cfg);produce(producer,name,original)
    identity=str(admin.describe_topics(TopicCollection([name]))[name].result(5).topic_id)
    ledger=pathlib.Path(directory)/'authority.sqlite3';db=sqlite3.connect(ledger)
    db.executescript('CREATE TABLE authority(topic_id TEXT,next_offset INTEGER);CREATE TABLE effects(source_offset INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,payload BLOB);')
    db.execute('INSERT INTO authority VALUES(?,2)',(identity,));db.executemany('INSERT INTO effects VALUES(?,?)',list(enumerate(original[:2])));db.commit();db.close()
    old=consumer(bootstrap,group)
    try:old.assign([TopicPartition(name,0,0)]);old.commit(offsets=[TopicPartition(name,0,2)],asynchronous=False)
    finally:old.close()
    observer=consumer(bootstrap,group);tick=time.monotonic()
    try:
        assert observer.committed([TopicPartition(name,0)],timeout=4)[0].offset==2
        deadline=time.monotonic()+72
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            current=observer.committed([TopicPartition(name,0)],timeout=4)[0].offset
            if current<0:break
            time.sleep(.4)
        else:raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: real one-minute offset expiry did not occur')
        assert time.monotonic()-tick>=59
    finally:observer.close()
    print('NATIVE_REAL_RETENTION_EXPIRY_PROVEN:'+str(round(time.monotonic()-tick,3)),flush=True)
    approval={'approved':True,'authority':'owned-durable-business-ledger','topic_id':identity}
    latest=Consumer(dict(cfg,**{'group.id':group,'auto.offset.reset':'latest','enable.auto.commit':False,'enable.partition.eof':True}))
    try:
        join(latest,name);deadline=time.monotonic()+5;end=None
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            message=latest.poll(.1)
            if message is not None and message.error() and message.error().code()==-191:end=message.offset();break
            assert message is None or message.error(),'latest replayed old backlog unexpectedly'
        assert end==5
        fresh=uuid.uuid4().bytes;produce(producer,name,[fresh]);new=next_message(latest);assert new.offset()==5 and new.value()==fresh
        try:task.recover_offsets(cfg,name,group,ledger,approval)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('active real group was allowed to reset')
    finally:latest.close()
    for change in [{'approved':False},{'authority':''},{'topic_id':'recreated-topic'}]:
        try:task.recover_offsets(cfg,name,group,ledger,{**approval,**change})
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('unsafe unapproved/foreign-source recovery accepted')
        observed=consumer(bootstrap,group)
        try:assert observed.committed([TopicPartition(name,0)],timeout=4)[0].offset<0,'rejected recovery mutated expired offset'
        finally:observed.close()
    try:task.recover_offsets(cfg,name,group,ledger,approval,fail_after_effect=True)
    except RuntimeError as error:assert 'injected-after-durable-effect' in str(error)
    else:raise AssertionError('durable-effect/Kafka-commit crash boundary not exercised')
    db=sqlite3.connect(ledger)
    try:assert db.execute('SELECT next_offset FROM authority').fetchone()[0]==3 and db.execute('SELECT payload FROM effects WHERE source_offset=2').fetchone()[0]==original[2]
    finally:db.close()
    observed=consumer(bootstrap,group)
    try:assert observed.committed([TopicPartition(name,0)],timeout=4)[0].offset==2,'crash falsely committed unfinished Kafka offset'
    finally:observed.close()
    result=task.recover_offsets(cfg,name,group,ledger,approval)
    assert result=={'start':3,'end':6,'applied':3,'topic_id':identity},result
    db=sqlite3.connect(ledger)
    try:assert db.execute('SELECT * FROM effects ORDER BY source_offset').fetchall()==list(enumerate(original+[fresh])) and db.execute('SELECT next_offset FROM authority').fetchone()[0]==6
    finally:db.close()
    observed=consumer(bootstrap,group)
    try:assert observed.committed([TopicPartition(name,0)],timeout=4)[0].offset==6
    finally:observed.close()
    print('NATIVE_OFFSET_EXPIRY_LATEST_SKIP_AND_AUTHORITY_CRASH_SAFE_REPLAY_PROVEN',flush=True)
    print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

"""Private grader fixture: genuine self-contained Kafka 4 KRaft, loopback only."""
import os
import pathlib
import signal
import socket
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import uuid
from contextlib import contextmanager

from confluent_kafka import Consumer, KafkaException, Producer, TopicPartition
from confluent_kafka.admin import AdminClient, NewTopic


def port():
    with socket.socket() as sock:
        sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
        return sock.getsockname()[1]


@contextmanager
def broker(sasl=False,expose=False,overrides=None):
    """Own only this Java process group; never access Docker or external services."""
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='opsforge-kafka-') as directory:
        root = pathlib.Path(directory)
        client_port, controller_port = port(), port()
        while controller_port == client_port:
            controller_port = port()
        bootstrap = f'127.0.0.1:{client_port}'
        config = root / 'server.properties'
        config.write_text('\n'.join([
            'process.roles=broker,controller', 'node.id=1',
            f'controller.quorum.bootstrap.servers=127.0.0.1:{controller_port}',
            f'listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap},CONTROLLER://127.0.0.1:{controller_port}',
            f'advertised.listeners=PLAINTEXT://{bootstrap}',
            'listener.security.protocol.map=PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT',
            'controller.listener.names=CONTROLLER', 'inter.broker.listener.name=PLAINTEXT',
            f'log.dirs={root}/data', 'num.partitions=3',
            'offsets.topic.replication.factor=1', 'offsets.topic.num.partitions=1',
            'transaction.state.log.replication.factor=1', 'transaction.state.log.min.isr=1',
            'transaction.state.log.num.partitions=1', 'group.initial.rebalance.delay.ms=0', 'group.min.session.timeout.ms=500',
            'auto.create.topics.enable=false', 'log.segment.bytes=10485760',
            'num.network.threads=2', 'num.io.threads=2',
        ]) + '\n')
        if overrides:
            with config.open('a') as extra:
                for key,value in overrides.items():extra.write(str(key)+'='+str(value)+'\n')
        if sasl:
            content=config.read_text()
            content=content.replace('PLAINTEXT://','CLIENT://').replace('PLAINTEXT:PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT','CLIENT:SASL_PLAINTEXT,CONTROLLER:PLAINTEXT').replace('inter.broker.listener.name=PLAINTEXT','inter.broker.listener.name=CLIENT')
            content+='sasl.enabled.mechanisms=PLAIN\nsasl.mechanism.inter.broker.protocol=PLAIN\n'
            content+='listener.name.client.plain.sasl.jaas.config=org.apache.kafka.common.security.plain.PlainLoginModule required username="admin" password="admin-secret" user_admin="admin-secret" user_old="old-secret" user_new="new-secret" user_intruder="intruder-secret";\n'
            content+='authorizer.class.name=org.apache.kafka.metadata.authorizer.StandardAuthorizer\nsuper.users=User:admin;User:ANONYMOUS\n'
            config.write_text(content)
        env = dict(os.environ, KAFKA_HEAP_OPTS='-Xms64m -Xmx256m -XX:ActiveProcessorCount=1', LOG_DIR=str(root / 'logs'))
        # JAVA_HOME is supplied by the deliverable image (glibc JDK17+).
        storage = ['/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-storage.sh', 'format', '--standalone',
                   '-t', uuid.uuid4().hex[:22], '-c', str(config)]
        formatted = subprocess.run(storage, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=20)
        assert formatted.returncode == 0, formatted.stderr + formatted.stdout
        log = open(root / 'broker.log', 'w+')
        proc = subprocess.Popen(['/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-server-start.sh', str(config)],
                                env=env, stdout=log, stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,
                                start_new_session=True)
        try:
            deadline = time.monotonic() + 35
            admin = AdminClient(dict(auth(bootstrap,'admin') if sasl else {'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap}, **{'socket.timeout.ms':1000}))
            ready = False
            while time.monotonic() < deadline:
                if proc.poll() is not None:
                    break
                try:
                    if admin.list_topics(timeout=1).brokers:
                        ready = True
                        break
                except KafkaException:
                    time.sleep(.2)
            if not ready:
                log.flush(); log.seek(0)
                raise AssertionError('self-started Kafka readiness failed: ' + log.read()[-9000:])
            def restart():
                nonlocal proc
                if proc.poll() is None:
                    os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGTERM)
                    try:proc.wait(timeout=8)
                    except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:os.killpg(proc.pid,signal.SIGKILL);proc.wait(timeout=3)
                proc=subprocess.Popen(['/opt/kafka/bin/kafka-server-start.sh',str(config)],env=env,stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,start_new_session=True)
                import struct
                deadline=time.monotonic()+30
                while time.monotonic()<deadline:
                    if proc.poll() is not None:break
                    try:
                        host,port_number=bootstrap.split(':')
                        with socket.create_connection((host,int(port_number)),timeout=.5) as channel:
                            payload=struct.pack('>hhih',18,0,42,4)+b'test'
                            channel.sendall(struct.pack('>i',len(payload))+payload)
                            size=channel.recv(4)
                            if len(size)==4:
                                response=channel.recv(struct.unpack('>i',size)[0])
                                if len(response)>=6 and struct.unpack('>i',response[:4])[0]==42:return
                    except OSError:time.sleep(.2)
                raise AssertionError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: restart not ready')
            print('NATIVE_KAFKA_READY',flush=True)
            yield {'bootstrap':bootstrap,'config':config,'restart':restart} if expose else bootstrap
        finally:
            metrics={}
            for key in ['memory.peak','pids.peak']:
                location=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/key
                if location.exists():metrics[key]=int(location.read_text())
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_SNAPSHOT:'+__import__('json').dumps(metrics),flush=True)
            if proc.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    proc.wait(timeout=3)
            log.close()


def topic(bootstrap, name, partitions=1, config=None):
    admin = AdminClient({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap})
    admin.create_topics([NewTopic(name, partitions, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)


def produce(producer, name, values, partition=0, expected_error=None):
    errors = []
    for value in values:
        producer.produce(name, value, partition=partition,
                         on_delivery=lambda err, message: errors.append(err))
    assert producer.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(values), errors
    if expected_error is None:
        assert all(error is None for error in errors), errors
    else:
        assert all(error and error.code() == expected_error for error in errors), errors


def consumer(bootstrap, group=None, isolation='read_committed'):
    return Consumer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'isolation.level': isolation,
                     'enable.partition.eof': True, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'fetch.wait.max.ms': 50})


def read(bootstrap, name, isolation='read_committed', seconds=2):
    client = consumer(bootstrap, isolation=isolation)
    values = []
    try:
        client.assign([TopicPartition(name, 0, 0)])
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            message = client.poll(.1)
            if message is not None and not message.error():
                values.append(message.value())
        return values
    finally:
        client.close()


def tx(bootstrap, transaction_id):
    producer = Producer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'transactional.id': transaction_id,
                         'transaction.timeout.ms': 30000, 'message.timeout.ms': 10000})
    producer.init_transactions(15)
    return producer


def auth(bootstrap,user):
    return {'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap,'security.protocol':'SASL_PLAINTEXT','sasl.mechanism':'PLAIN','sasl.username':user,'sasl.password':user+'-secret','socket.timeout.ms':5000}


def next_message(client,seconds=8):
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        message=client.poll(.1)
        if message is not None:
            if not message.error():return message
            if message.error().code()!=-191:raise KafkaException(message.error())
    raise AssertionError('expected real Kafka message before deadline')


def committed(bootstrap,name,group,partition=0):
    c=consumer(bootstrap,group)
    try:return c.committed([TopicPartition(name,partition)],timeout=8)[0].offset
    finally:c.close()


def join(client,topic_name,seconds=12):
    client.subscribe([topic_name])
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        client.poll(.05)
        if client.assignment():return client.assignment()
    raise AssertionError('real group assignment not received')

        if sasl:
            content=config.read_text()

            yield {'bootstrap':bootstrap,'config':config,'restart':restart} if expose else bootstrap
        finally:
            metrics={}
            for key in ['memory.peak','pids.peak']:
                location=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/key
                if location.exists():metrics[key]=int(location.read_text())
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_SNAPSHOT:'+__import__('json').dumps(metrics),flush=True)
            if proc.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    proc.wait(timeout=3)
            log.close()


def topic(bootstrap, name, partitions=1, config=None):
    admin = AdminClient({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap})
    admin.create_topics([NewTopic(name, partitions, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)


def produce(producer, name, values, partition=0, expected_error=None):
    errors = []
    for value in values:
        producer.produce(name, value, partition=partition,
                         on_delivery=lambda err, message: errors.append(err))
    assert producer.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(values), errors
    if expected_error is None:
        assert all(error is None for error in errors), errors
    else:
        assert all(error and error.code() == expected_error for error in errors), errors


def consumer(bootstrap, group=None, isolation='read_committed'):
    return Consumer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'isolation.level': isolation,
                     'enable.partition.eof': True, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'fetch.wait.max.ms': 50})


def read(bootstrap, name, isolation='read_committed', seconds=2):
    client = consumer(bootstrap, isolation=isolation)
    values = []
    try:
        client.assign([TopicPartition(name, 0, 0)])
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            message = client.poll(.1)
            if message is not None and not message.error():
                values.append(message.value())
        return values
    finally:
        client.close()


def tx(bootstrap, transaction_id):
    producer = Producer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'transactional.id': transaction_id,
                         'transaction.timeout.ms': 30000, 'message.timeout.ms': 10000})
    producer.init_transactions(15)
    return producer


def auth(bootstrap,user):
    return {'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap,'security.protocol':'SASL_PLAINTEXT','sasl.mechanism':'PLAIN','sasl.username':user,'sasl.password':user+'-secret','socket.timeout.ms':5000}


def next_message(client,seconds=8):
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        message=client.poll(.1)
        if message is not None:
            if not message.error():return message
            if message.error().code()!=-191:raise KafkaException(message.error())
    raise AssertionError('expected real Kafka message before deadline')


def committed(bootstrap,name,group,partition=0):
    c=consumer(bootstrap,group)
    try:return c.committed([TopicPartition(name,partition)],timeout=8)[0].offset
    finally:c.close()


def join(client,topic_name,seconds=12):
    client.subscribe([topic_name])
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        client.poll(.05)
        if client.assignment():return client.assignment()
    raise AssertionError('real group assignment not received')

## 环境与初始材料
Kafka4.0.0 KRaft、Java17、confluent-kafka2.10.1；真实隔离broker与native客户端，无外部服务/宿主socket，2GiB/2CPU/PID768分布式档。

## 操作任务
实现recover_processing(config,name,group,handle,processing_bound_ms,allowed_max_poll_ms)。夹具原client session2秒/heartbeat0.5秒/max.poll3秒；真实业务延迟注入4.2秒且SQLite效果已持久化后，native客户端确实报告_MAX_POLL_EXCEEDED，旧client已关闭。复制配置重入原组，max.poll设置为测得处理上界+1000ms余量，并受6000ms允许上界约束，不得无限延长或只改session；非法/无法同时满足的有限预算拒绝且不产生效果。实际消费给定源到原生high，调用幂等handle且在其持久化后同步提交连续位点；记录关闭前原生revoke次数。返回max_poll_ms/committed/processed/revokes_before_close，不修改调用方原配置。

## 提交产物
solution.py及操作产生的业务状态/审计产物。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；动态真实native数据、前提和错误反例，环境错误不计有效wrong拒绝；120秒内完成。位点过期题包含真实至少1分钟等待。

## 能力边界
真实Kafka KRaft/经典consumer group与native librdkafka max.poll检查；处理延迟为明确4.2秒故障注入，非吞吐实测。单分区、有明确可满足的业务SLO与幂等SQLite效果，验证heartbeat不能抵消max.poll、原组重入、持续业务处理不再失权。不是既有多worker公平调度题，也不声称无限处理时长可仅靠参数修复。

import tempfile,sqlite3
from confluent_kafka import KafkaError
with broker(overrides={'group.min.session.timeout.ms':'500'}) as bootstrap,tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='owned-processing-ledger-') as directory:
    name='processing-'+uuid.uuid4().hex;group='group-'+uuid.uuid4().hex;topic(bootstrap,name)
    config={'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap,'group.id':group,'enable.auto.commit':False,'auto.offset.reset':'earliest','session.timeout.ms':2000,'heartbeat.interval.ms':500,'max.poll.interval.ms':3000,'log_level':0}
    producer=Producer({'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap,'log_level':0});values=[uuid.uuid4().bytes for _ in range(3)];produce(producer,name,values)
    db=sqlite3.connect(pathlib.Path(directory)/'effects.sqlite3');db.execute('CREATE TABLE effects(source_offset INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,payload BLOB)');db.commit();durations=[]
    def handle(message):
        previous=db.execute('SELECT payload FROM effects WHERE source_offset=?',(message.offset(),)).fetchone()
        if previous:
            assert previous[0]==message.value(),'business duplicate identity conflicts'
            return
        start=time.monotonic();time.sleep(4.2)
        with db:db.execute('INSERT INTO effects VALUES(?,?)',(message.offset(),message.value()))
        durations.append(time.monotonic()-start)
    failed=Consumer(config)
    try:
        failed.subscribe([name]);first=next_message(failed);assert first.offset()==0
        handle(first);codes=[];deadline=time.monotonic()+5
        while time.monotonic()<deadline:
            message=failed.poll(.1)
            if message is not None and message.error():
                codes.append(message.error().code())
                if message.error().code()==KafkaError._MAX_POLL_EXCEEDED:break
        assert KafkaError._MAX_POLL_EXCEEDED in codes,'native max.poll violation not reproduced'
    finally:failed.close()
    print('NATIVE_MAX_POLL_EXCEEDED_AFTER_REAL_PROCESSING_DELAY:'+str(codes),flush=True)
    for bound,limit in [(0,6000),(4500,1000),(7000,6000),(4500,1000000000)]:
        try:task.recover_processing(config,name,group,handle,bound,limit)
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('unbounded processing/session policy accepted')
        assert db.execute('SELECT count(*) FROM effects').fetchone()[0]==1,'rejected policy changed business effects'
    result=task.recover_processing(config,name,group,handle,4500,6000)
    assert result=={'max_poll_ms':5500,'committed':3,'processed':[0,1,2],'revokes_before_close':0},result
    assert config['max.poll.interval.ms']==3000,'caller/default client configuration was mutated'
    assert db.execute('SELECT * FROM effects ORDER BY source_offset').fetchall()==list(enumerate(values)) and len(durations)==3
    observed=consumer(bootstrap,group)
    try:assert observed.committed([TopicPartition(name,0)],timeout=4)[0].offset==3
    finally:observed.close();db.close()
    print('NATIVE_BOUNDED_PROCESSING_BUDGET_STABLE_GROUP_AND_DURABLE_EFFECTS_PROVEN',flush=True)
    print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

                                response=channel.recv(struct.unpack('>i',size)[0])
                                if len(response)>=6 and struct.unpack('>i',response[:4])[0]==42:return
                    except OSError:time.sleep(.2)
                raise AssertionError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: restart not ready')
            print('NATIVE_KAFKA_READY',flush=True)
            yield {'bootstrap':bootstrap,'config':config,'restart':restart} if expose else bootstrap
        finally:
            metrics={}
            for key in ['memory.peak','pids.peak']:
                location=pathlib.Path('/sys/fs/cgroup')/key
                if location.exists():metrics[key]=int(location.read_text())
            print('NATIVE_RESOURCE_SNAPSHOT:'+__import__('json').dumps(metrics),flush=True)
            if proc.poll() is None:
                os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGTERM)
                try:
                    proc.wait(timeout=8)
                except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:
                    os.killpg(proc.pid, signal.SIGKILL)
                    proc.wait(timeout=3)
            log.close()


def topic(bootstrap, name, partitions=1, config=None):
    admin = AdminClient({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap})
    admin.create_topics([NewTopic(name, partitions, 1, config=config or {})])[name].result(10)


def produce(producer, name, values, partition=0, expected_error=None):
    errors = []
    for value in values:
        producer.produce(name, value, partition=partition,
                         on_delivery=lambda err, message: errors.append(err))
    assert producer.flush(10) == 0
    assert len(errors) == len(values), errors
    if expected_error is None:
        assert all(error is None for error in errors), errors
    else:
        assert all(error and error.code() == expected_error for error in errors), errors


def consumer(bootstrap, group=None, isolation='read_committed'):
    return Consumer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'group.id': group or uuid.uuid4().hex,
                     'enable.auto.commit': False, 'isolation.level': isolation,
                     'enable.partition.eof': True, 'auto.offset.reset': 'earliest',
                     'fetch.wait.max.ms': 50})


def read(bootstrap, name, isolation='read_committed', seconds=2):
    client = consumer(bootstrap, isolation=isolation)
    values = []
    try:
        client.assign([TopicPartition(name, 0, 0)])
        deadline = time.monotonic() + seconds
        while time.monotonic() < deadline:
            message = client.poll(.1)
            if message is not None and not message.error():
                values.append(message.value())
        return values
    finally:
        client.close()


def tx(bootstrap, transaction_id):
    producer = Producer({'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers': bootstrap, 'transactional.id': transaction_id,
                         'transaction.timeout.ms': 30000, 'message.timeout.ms': 10000})
    producer.init_transactions(15)
    return producer


def auth(bootstrap,user):
    return {'log_level':0,'bootstrap.servers':bootstrap,'security.protocol':'SASL_PLAINTEXT','sasl.mechanism':'PLAIN','sasl.username':user,'sasl.password':user+'-secret','socket.timeout.ms':5000}


def next_message(client,seconds=8):
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        message=client.poll(.1)
        if message is not None:
            if not message.error():return message
            if message.error().code()!=-191:raise KafkaException(message.error())
    raise AssertionError('expected real Kafka message before deadline')


def committed(bootstrap,name,group,partition=0):
    c=consumer(bootstrap,group)
    try:return c.committed([TopicPartition(name,partition)],timeout=8)[0].offset
    finally:c.close()


def join(client,topic_name,seconds=12):
    client.subscribe([topic_name])
    deadline=time.monotonic()+seconds
    while time.monotonic()<deadline:
        client.poll(.05)
        if client.assignment():return client.assignment()
    raise AssertionError('real group assignment not received')

title: 真实JBOD目录离线：核对副本权威并恢复原目录、原权限与原broker
body:
## 环境与初始材料
Kafka4.0.0 KRaft、Java17、confluent-kafka2.10.1；真实隔离broker与native客户端，无外部服务/宿主socket，2GiB/2CPU/PID768分布式档。

## 操作任务
实现recover_jbod(c,target,healthy,manifest)。真实三controller+三broker且每broker双log目录；夹具仅使broker1目标partition目录失去写权限，真实segment roll触发KafkaStorageException，该log目录offline，另目录仍在线可写，leader已转到存活权威副本。manifest须批准精确broker/原partition/failed目录/原mode/原topic UUID/存活authority_brokers和已确认消息hash。先用原生DescribeLogDirs/ISR/minISR和存活leader原生读取核对，拒绝无权威、越路径或chmod777范围；只恢复精确原mode，重启原broker及原metadata/data，不format或重建topic。等ISR3、双目录online，校对全部已提交原生日志与身份/原权限，返回broker_id/online_dirs排序/isr排序/topic_id。健康目录、原配置和所有topic身份均须保留。

## 提交产物
solution.py及操作产生的业务状态/审计产物。

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；动态真实native数据、前提和错误反例，环境错误不计有效wrong拒绝；120秒内完成。位点过期题包含真实至少1分钟等待。

## 能力边界
真实Kafka4分离3controller+3broker、RF3/minISR2，每broker两目录，2GiB/2CPU/PID768；用自有非root目录EACCES+真实log roll受控故障触发native offline，非物理坏盘/EIO注入。恢复依据是实际存活leader已提交日志、ISR与已确认记录hash，不声称对每个磁盘做独立离线字节校验；不向未知坏盘复制数据、不做新cluster format。原文件mode精确恢复并检查健康路径不变；没有宿主socket/外部服务或生产变更。
review_note: Kafka批次5：真实原生机制触发与恢复，动态输入、审批/身份/范围边界及独立语义反例。
rubric: 交付物和验收对应题述数据边界
失败时不掩盖遗漏或未知结果

import pathlib,sys,json,time,uuid,os
sys.path[:0]=[str(pathlib.Path.cwd()),str(pathlib.Path.cwd()/"checks")]
import solution as task
from native import *
import inspect,functools
def _trace_operation(name,function):
    @functools.wraps(function)
    def invoke(*args,**kwargs):
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:'+name,flush=True)
        try:result=function(*args,**kwargs)
        except BaseException:
            print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RAISED:'+name,flush=True)
            raise
        print('STUDENT_OPERATION_RETURNED:'+name,flush=True)
        return result
    return invoke
for _name,_function in list(vars(task).items()):
    if not _name.startswith('_') and inspect.isfunction(_function) and _function.__module__=='solution':setattr(task,_name,_trace_operation(_name,_function))
import hashlib
from confluent_kafka import TopicCollection
from jbod_material import prepare_jbod_fault,snapshot
with cluster() as c:
    material=prepare_jbod_fault(c);target=material['target'];healthy=material['healthy'];native=c.partition(target)
    manifest={'approved':True,'broker_id':1,'partition_dir':str(material['partition_path']),'failed_dir':str(material['failed_dir']),'original_mode':material['original_mode'],'topic_id':material['topic_ids'][target],'authority_brokers':list(native.isrs),'acknowledged_hashes':[hashlib.sha256(value).hexdigest() for value in material['acknowledged']]}
    before_mode=material['partition_path'].stat().st_mode&0o7777;pid=c.nodes[1]['process'].pid
    for change in [{'approved':False},{'partition_dir':str(c.root/'unrelated')},{'original_mode':0o777},{'topic_id':'new-empty-topic'},{'authority_brokers':[1]}]:
        try:task.recover_jbod(c,target,healthy,{**manifest,**change})
        except ValueError:pass
        else:raise AssertionError('unsafe approval/path/permission/topic/replica authority accepted')
        assert c.nodes[1]['process'].pid==pid and material['partition_path'].stat().st_mode&0o7777==before_mode,'rejected request changed original process/access'
        assert c.identity()==material['identity'],'rejected request rewrote original metadata/config'
    result=task.recover_jbod(c,target,healthy,manifest)
    expected_dirs=sorted(str(path) for path in c.nodes[1]['node'].glob('data-*'))
    assert result=={'broker_id':1,'online_dirs':expected_dirs,'isr':[1,2,3],'topic_id':material['topic_ids'][target]},result
    assert c.nodes[1]['process'].pid!=pid,'original failed runtime did not restart'
    assert c.identity()==material['identity'] and min_isr(c.config(),target)==2,'storage identity/durability policy weakened'
    for path,mode in material['original_modes'].items():assert pathlib.Path(path).stat().st_mode&0o7777==mode,'original permissions changed or widened: '+path
    assert all(not item.get('error') for item in c.log_dirs(1)['brokers'][0]['logDirs'])
    assert all(str(c.admin().describe_topics(TopicCollection([name]))[name].result(5).topic_id)==identity for name,identity in material['topic_ids'].items() if name in [target,healthy])
    assert snapshot(c,target)==material['authority'],'acknowledged/committed native history differs after repair'
    healthy_before=snapshot(c,healthy);marker=uuid.uuid4().bytes;assert emit(c.config(),healthy,marker)==0
    assert snapshot(c,healthy)['values']==healthy_before['values']+[marker],'healthy original directory service regressed'
    print('NATIVE_JBOD_DIR_OFFLINE_AUTHORITY_EXACT_PERMISSION_AND_ORIGINAL_BROKER_RECOVERY_PROVEN',flush=True)
    print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)

"""Create owned real JBOD roll/EACCES failure with intact authoritative replicas."""
import hashlib,json,pathlib,time,uuid
from confluent_kafka import Producer,Consumer,TopicPartition,TopicCollection
from confluent_kafka.admin import NewTopic
from native import emit

def snapshot(c,name):
 reader=Consumer(dict(c.config(),**{'group.id':'authority-'+uuid.uuid4().hex,'enable.auto.commit':False,'enable.partition.eof':True,'isolation.level':'read_committed'}));values=[]
 try:
  low,high=reader.get_watermark_offsets(TopicPartition(name,0),timeout=5);reader.assign([TopicPartition(name,0,low)]);deadline=time.monotonic()+8
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   message=reader.poll(.1)
   if message is None:continue
   if message.error():
    if message.error().code()==-191 and message.offset()>=high:return {'low':low,'high':high,'values':values}
    continue
   values.append(message.value())
  raise RuntimeError('NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: authority full native read not completed')
 finally:reader.close()

def prepare_jbod_fault(c):
 def event(phase,**values):print('NATIVE_JBOD_STAGE:'+phase,flush=True)
 event('six-native-nodes-ready');names=[];locations={};node=c.nodes[1]['node']
 for _ in range(4):
  name='jbod-'+uuid.uuid4().hex;c.admin().create_topics([NewTopic(name,num_partitions=1,replica_assignment=[[1,2,3]],config={'min.insync.replicas':'2','segment.bytes':'4096'})])[name].result(10);c.partition(name,3)
  deadline=time.monotonic()+5;path=None
  while time.monotonic()<deadline:
   found=list(node.glob('data-*/'+name+'-0'))
   if found:path=found[0];break
   time.sleep(.1)
  assert path is not None
  names.append(name);locations[name]=path
  if len({p.parent for p in locations.values()})==2:break
 assert len({p.parent for p in locations.values()})==2,locations
 target=names[0];target_path=locations[target];healthy=next(name for name in names if locations[name].parent!=target_path.parent)
 before=c.identity();topic_ids={name:str(c.admin().describe_topics(TopicCollection([name]))[name].result(5).topic_id) for name in [target,healthy]}
 initial=b'acknowledged-before-directory-fault-'+uuid.uuid4().bytes;assert emit(c.config(),target,initial)==0
 healthy_before=b'healthy-directory-before-'+uuid.uuid4().bytes;assert emit(c.config(),healthy,healthy_before)==0
 event('two-native-log-directories-and-authoritative-replicas-proven',target_dir=str(target_path.parent),healthy_dir=str(locations[healthy].parent),native=c.log_dirs(1))
 # Own nonroot filesystem only: existing files remain open; forced real segment
 # roll will hit EACCES creating the next segment in this one partition directory.
 known_paths={path for info in c.nodes.values() if info['role']=='broker' for path in info['node'].glob('data-*')}|{target_path,locations[healthy]}
 original_modes={str(path):path.stat().st_mode&0o7777 for path in known_paths};c.expected_modes=dict(original_modes)
 original_mode=original_modes[str(target_path)]
 target_path.chmod(0o500);event('owned-partition-directory-write-permission-removed',directory=str(target_path))
 p=Producer(dict(c.config(),**{'acks':'all','enable.idempotence':True,'message.timeout.ms':8000}));acknowledged=[initial];uncertain=[]
 for index in range(24):
  token=('roll-'+str(index)+'-'+uuid.uuid4().hex).encode()*10;delivery=[]
  p.produce(target,token,partition=0,on_delivery=lambda err,msg:delivery.append(str(err) if err else None));p.flush(10)
  if delivery==[None]:acknowledged.append(token)
  else:uncertain.append({'record_hex':token.hex(),'delivery':delivery})
 native=c.log_dirs(1);entries=native['brokers'][0]['logDirs']
 failed=[entry for entry in entries if pathlib.Path(entry['logDir'])==target_path.parent]
 good=[entry for entry in entries if pathlib.Path(entry['logDir'])==locations[healthy].parent]
 assert len(failed)==len(good)==1 and failed[0].get('error') and not good[0].get('error'),native
 assert c.nodes[1]['process'].poll() is None,'one failed directory killed all broker service'
 healthy_during=b'healthy-directory-during-'+uuid.uuid4().bytes;assert emit(c.config(),healthy,healthy_during)==0
 event('actual-native-log-dir-offline-other-dir-serves',native=native,acknowledged=len(acknowledged),uncertain=len(uncertain),affected_leader=c.partition(target).leader)
 p.flush(8)
 del p
 authority=snapshot(c,target)
 assert all(value in authority['values'] for value in acknowledged),'NATIVE_ENVIRONMENT_ERROR: acknowledged replica authority not available'
 print('NATIVE_JBOD_OFFLINE_ERROR:'+str(failed[0]['error']),flush=True)
 return {'target':target,'healthy':healthy,'partition_path':target_path,'failed_dir':target_path.parent,'healthy_dir':locations[healthy].parent,'original_modes':original_modes,'original_mode':original_mode,'identity':before,'topic_ids':topic_ids,'acknowledged':acknowledged,'uncertain':uncertain,'authority':authority}
